aka.zh: 沪崇苏高速公路（上海段，A14）

tagline.en: Under and over the mouth of the Yangtze to Chongming and Qidong, then inland across the Huai valley and the Qinling to Xi'an
tagline.zh: 在长江口一隧两桥过崇明、到启东，再西行穿越淮河流域与秦岭直抵西安

start.en: Wuhaogou in Gaodong, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, at the Shanghai Ring Expressway, just south of the Yangtze tunnel
start.zh: 上海市浦东新区高东镇五号沟，接上海绕城高速，长江隧道南口附近

end.en: The Tianwang interchange on the Xi'an ring expressway, in Baqiao district, Xi'an
end.zh: 陕西省西安市灞桥区西安绕城高速田王枢纽立交

en: G40 is the Yangtze delta's road to the north-west, 1,526 km on the chainage and in the 2022 plan. It starts on the Pudong shore, goes under the south channel of the Yangtze to Changxing Island and over the north channel to Chongming, crosses the island and then the North Branch into Jiangsu at Qidong. From there it runs west along the north bank through Haimen, Nantong, Rugao, Taixing, Taizhou, Jiangdu, Yangzhou and Yizheng to the northern side of Nanjing, enters Anhui at Wuzhuang and continues by Quanjiao, Hefei and Lu'an, crosses southern Henan through Gushi, Huangchuan, Xinyang, Tanghe, Nanyang and Xixia, and climbs through Shangluo and over the Qinling to Xi'an. It is also part of Asian Highway 5.

By the chainage, Shanghai has 57 km, Jiangsu 426, Anhui 253, Henan 518 and Shaanxi 245. For much of the way it shares the road with other routes: G15 around Nantong, G2 from Guangling to Zhengyi, G36 and the Nanjing ring road at Luhe, and G42 for about 260 km from Pukou in Nanjing through Hefei to Dagudian in Lu'an.

The Wuzhuang toll plaza on the Anhui–Jiangsu boundary, with 12 + 24 lanes, is described by its operator, Anhui Expressway, as the largest in Asia; it reported 126,000 vehicles in a day during the return rush after the 2025 Spring Festival.
zh: G40 是长三角通往西北的通道，按里程桩号及 2022 年规划全长 1,526 公里。它自浦东江岸起，以隧道穿越长江南港至长兴岛，以大桥跨越北港至崇明岛，横穿全岛后跨过长江北支进入江苏启东。此后沿长江北岸西行，经海门、南通、如皋、泰兴、泰州、江都、扬州、仪征至南京江北，在吴庄进入安徽，经全椒、合肥、六安，横贯豫南经固始、潢川、信阳、唐河、南阳、西峡，再穿过商洛、翻越秦岭抵达西安。它同时是亚洲公路 5 号线的一部分。
按里程桩号，上海段 57 公里、江苏段 426 公里、安徽段 253 公里、河南段 518 公里、陕西段 245 公里。全线多处与其他路线共线：南通一带与 G15、广陵至正谊与 G2、六合一带与 G36 及南京绕城高速，自南京浦口经合肥至六安大顾店约 260 公里与 G42 共线。
苏皖界的吴庄收费站有 12 + 24 条收费车道，运营方安徽皖通高速称其为亚洲最大的收费站；2025 年春节后返程高峰期间，该站单日通行量最高达 12.6 万辆次。

en: The eastern end is a chain of three Yangtze crossings. The Shanghai Yangtze tunnel, 8.95 km under the south channel, is a double-deck tunnel: six lanes for 80 km/h on top, an escape passage below that was originally reserved for a metro line. The Shanghai Yangtze bridge continues for 16.63 km across Changxing Island and the north channel, 9.97 km of it bridge, with a cable-stayed main span. Both opened on 31 October 2009. The Chongqi crossing over the North Branch to Qidong is a 51.76 km project with a 6.84 km six-lane bridge; Xinhua described it on opening in 2011 as the longest-span and longest continuous steel box-girder bridge in China.

The western end crosses the Qinling. The Xi'an–Shangzhou section, 118.975 km, has 21 tunnels and 179 bridges, 57 per cent of its length, rising to 96.5 per cent in the Qinling mountain section; the Shaanxi transport department calls it the first six-lane expressway through the Qinling. Its longest tunnel, the Qinling Bayuan tunnel, is about 5.44 km per bore and carries three lanes each way. The road is eight lanes from Xi'an to Lantian and six from Lantian east as far as Xinyang, by Chinese Wikipedia's account; Shangzhou to the Henan border is designed for 100 km/h, 80 between Danfeng and Zhulinguan.
zh: 东端由三处长江通道串成。上海长江隧道在南港江底长 8.95 公里，为双层结构：上层为双向六车道，设计时速 80 公里，下层为逃生通道，原本预留给地铁。上海长江大桥接着横穿长兴岛、跨越北港，全长 16.63 公里，其中桥梁 9.97 公里，主桥为斜拉桥。二者于 2009 年 10 月 31 日同时通车。跨越北支至启东的崇启通道全长 51.76 公里，其中大桥 6.84 公里，双向六车道；新华社在 2011 年通车时称其为国内跨度和联长最长的钢箱梁桥。
西端翻越秦岭。西商段主线 118.975 公里，有隧道 21 座、桥梁 179 座，桥隧占总里程的 57%，秦岭山区段达 96.5%；陕西省交通运输厅称其为第一条穿越秦岭的六车道高速公路。最长的秦岭灞源隧道单洞约 5.44 公里，双向六车道。据中文维基百科，西安至蓝田段为双向八车道，蓝田以东至信阳为双向六车道；商州至豫陕界段设计时速 100 公里，丹凤至竹林关段 80 公里。

en: Two of the oldest pieces are in the middle. The Hefei–Nanjing expressway, Anhui's first, now shared with G42, was begun in October 1986 and opened on 4 October 1991. In Jiangsu the Nanjing–Nantong road opened on 28 November 1996 as a class-one highway and was brought up to expressway standard by 21 November 2000.

In Shaanxi the Shangzhou–Henan border section opened on 26 October 2008, together with the Lantian–Shangzhou expressway over the Qinling. Until 2012 G40 traffic for Xi'an used that road, which is now part of G70; the new six-lane Xi'an–Shangzhou section, begun on 24 December 2008, opened on 14 August 2012 and took over the number.

At the eastern end the Shanghai Yangtze tunnel and bridge opened on 31 October 2009, and the Chongqi bridge, begun in December 2008, on 24 December 2011, joining Chongming to Jiangsu. English Wikipedia dates the completion of the whole route to that opening; no Chinese source consulted says so directly. The number G40 comes from the 2005 national plan, in which east–west lines take even numbers counted from north to south.
zh: 最早的两段在中部。今与 G42 共线的合宁高速是安徽省第一条高速公路，1986 年 10 月动工，1991 年 10 月 4 日通车。江苏境内的宁通公路于 1996 年 11 月 28 日按一级公路通车，至 2000 年 11 月 21 日完成高速化改造。
陕西境内的商州至陕豫界段于 2008 年 10 月 26 日通车，翻越秦岭的蓝商高速同期开通。2012 年以前，G40 往西安的车流走蓝商高速，该路今属 G70；2008 年 12 月 24 日开工的六车道西商高速于 2012 年 8 月 14 日建成通车，接过了这一编号。
东端的上海长江隧桥于 2009 年 10 月 31 日通车；2008 年 12 月开工的崇启大桥于 2011 年 12 月 24 日通车，把崇明岛与江苏连起来。英文维基百科将全线建成定在这一天，所查中文来源未见直接说法。G40 编号来自 2005 年国家高速公路网规划，其中东西横线取偶数，自北向南编号。

en: No cost for the whole road has been published; it was built by five provinces and municipalities as separate projects. The three crossings at the eastern end are the best documented. The Shanghai Yangtze tunnel and bridge are put at 11.6 billion yuan by Jiefang Daily and 12.616 billion by a later Sohu article; the operating company holds a 25-year concession. The Chongqi crossing was budgeted at 8.238 billion, of which 4.571 billion for the Shanghai part, which the Shanghai Municipal Urban Construction Investment & Development Corporation paid for; Jiangsu built and runs its own part.

At the western end the Xi'an–Shangzhou section cost about 13 billion yuan, according to the Shaanxi Communications Construction Group, which runs it. The provincial government allowed it to charge tolls for twenty years, from 14 August 2012 to 13 August 2032, or until its loans are repaid if that is sooner.
zh: 全线总造价没有公开数字，由五个省市分项目建设。东端三处过江工程的资料最完整。上海长江隧桥的投资，《解放日报》称为 116 亿元，此后搜狐一篇文章称为 126.16 亿元；运营公司享有 25 年经营期。崇启通道初步设计总概算 82.38 亿元，其中上海段 45.71 亿元，由上海市城市建设投资开发总公司出资建设；江苏段由江苏自行建设和运营。
西端的西商高速总投资约 130 亿元，由运营方陕西省交通建设集团公布。陕西省政府批准其收费期限为 20 年，自 2012 年 8 月 14 日至 2032 年 8 月 13 日；如提前偿清贷款则须提前停止收费。

en: The Yangtze tunnel and bridge, three lanes each way and designed for 3,200 vehicles an hour, are regularly jammed at holidays, since they are Chongming's only road link to the rest of Shanghai. Since January 2024, at peak periods, traffic towards central Shanghai is metered by lane signals before the tunnel. On the Qinling section cars pay a 10-yuan surcharge for the Bayuan tunnel on top of the distance toll.
zh: 上海长江隧桥单向三车道，设计通行能力每小时 3,200 辆，是崇明岛与上海其他地区之间唯一的公路通道，节假日经常拥堵。自 2024 年 1 月起，大客流期间往上海市区方向在隧道前以车道信号灯控流。秦岭段除按里程收费外，小客车通过灞源隧道另加收 10 元。

why.en: No total has been published. G40 was built by Shanghai, Jiangsu, Anhui, Henan and Shaanxi as separately financed projects from 1986 to 2012, each accounted for on its own; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G40 由上海、江苏、安徽、河南、陕西五省市在 1986 至 2012 年间分项目分别筹资建设、分别核算；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: Reported at 11.6 billion yuan (Jiefang Daily) and 12.616 billion (Sohu, 2019); the two figures have not been reconciled. Opened 2009.
value.zh: 据报道为 116 亿元（《解放日报》）或 126.16 亿元（搜狐，2019 年），两个数字未经核对统一。2009 年通车。

figures.source: Jiefang Daily (jfdaily.com), 城事|长江隧桥通行费该不该取消？; Sohu, 通车快十年，关于上海长江隧桥你了解多少？, 2019

value.en: 8.238 billion yuan budgeted for 51.76 km, of which 4.571 billion for the Shanghai part (2008–2011)
value.zh: 51.76 公里初步设计总概算 82.38 亿元，其中上海段 45.71 亿元（2008—2011）

figures.source: Xinhua, 24 December 2011, via gov.cn; Shanghai Municipal Government press conference, December 2011, via sh148.org
Shaanxi Communications Construction Group, 西安至商州高速公路概况, archived, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 西安—商州高速公路

value.en: The provinces and municipalities along the route, repaid from tolls: in Shanghai the Shanghai Municipal Urban Construction Investment & Development Corporation; in Shaanxi the Shaanxi Communications Construction Group, with a twenty-year toll period to 2032 on Xi'an–Shangzhou.
value.zh: 沿线各省市出资，以通行费还贷：上海段由上海市城市建设投资开发总公司出资；陕西西商段由陕西省交通建设集团建设运营，收费期限 20 年，至 2032 年。

figures.source: Shanghai Municipal Government press conference, December 2011, via sh148.org; Shaanxi Provincial Government toll approval, 22 August 2012, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 西安—商州高速公路

value.en: 1,526 km on the chainage and in the 2022 plan (English Wikipedia gives 1,490 km)
value.zh: 按里程桩号及 2022 年规划为 1,526 公里（英文维基百科作 1,490 公里）

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 上海－西安高速公路 and 中华人民共和国国家高速公路网; English Wikipedia, G40 Shanghai–Xi'an Expressway

timeline.en: Work on the Hefei–Nanjing expressway begins in October.

timeline.zh: 10 月 4 日，合宁高速通车。

timeline.en: The Nanjing–Nantong road opens on 28 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 28 日，宁通公路通车。

timeline.en: Nanjing–Nantong is brought up to expressway standard by 21 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 21 日，宁通公路完成高速化改造。

timeline.en: The national expressway plan numbers the line G40.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将本线编为 G40。

timeline.en: Shangzhou–Henan border and the Lantian–Shangzhou road over the Qinling open on 26 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 26 日，商界高速与翻越秦岭的蓝商高速通车。

timeline.en: The Shanghai Yangtze tunnel and bridge open on 31 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 31 日，上海长江隧桥通车。

timeline.en: The Chongqi bridge opens on 24 December, joining Chongming to Jiangsu.
timeline.zh: 12 月 24 日，崇启大桥通车，崇明岛与江苏相连。

timeline.en: The six-lane Xi'an–Shangzhou section opens on 14 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 14 日，六车道西商高速建成通车。

timeline.en: Lane signals begin metering city-bound traffic at the Yangtze tunnel at peak periods in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月起，上海长江隧桥往市区方向在大客流期间实行车道信号灯控流。
